OFFLINE_EVAL (Stage-5): that collision is NOT full-bank behavioral equivalence — pair diverges under ['BOUNDARY', 'COMPOSITION', 'TRANSFORMED']. Therefore 0/7 is explained by over-broad identity-only FILTER_BEHAVIORAL_DUP (FALSE_DUPLICATE), not by genuine semantic equivalence of the collapsed pair. Solo 7/7 occurs because no competing behaviors value exists. Promote set unmodified.
